name: fail-open-rotate-script-node
description: fabro-491b: same-date review overwrite fixed by a deterministic fail-open rotate script node (.fabro/workflows/architect/scripts/rotate-review.nu) wired between survey and analyze in workflow.fabro: when the plain-date review exists, copy it verbatim to an mtime-derived timestamped sibling <date>-<HHmm>.md (-2/-3 disambiguation on collision); plain-date name always carries the latest pass. Fail-open: any error prints to stderr and exits 0 so rotation never blocks a pass. --reviews-dir flag makes it fixture-testable without touching real reviews. Gotcha: re-planting a fixture file with echo resets its mtime — touch -d the timestamp explicitly when testing the -2 collision path.
